svg.title: Control grows above an unchanged objective
svg.desc: Keep the original flag small and unchanged while branching accessible options above it. Increased control expands possible means; never replace the flag with a new crown, throne or power objective.

**Action:** Greater control enlarges the available solution space.

**Caption:**
> POWER HAS NOT BECOME THE GOAL.
>
> IT HAS BECOME USEFUL.
